metadata.description: GET /api/mam/apps/internal/{applicationId} for a macOS internal app, RE-CAPTURED live 2026-08-01 against <internal-env>/26.2.1614.12 using the fully placeholder vendored MacOSDMGTestApp.dmg + MacOSDMGTestApp-1.0.plist (chore/vendored-sdk-test-apps), replacing the original 2026-07-31 capture that used a real Chrome DMG + its shipped Munki pkginfo, to remove real-vendor-name residue from the committed fixture. The real live-captured id (65682) was anonymized here and re-baked as the literal path /api/mam/apps/internal/67003 (unchanged from the prior capture) to preserve the established collision-avoidance routing scheme this test's other fixtures/wantLocationID/capturedAppID already depend on -- the literal id in the path is an internal mock-routing choice, independent of any real tenant id. Anonymized via mock-capture's Anonymize() before commit. Because the source pkginfo plist was already fully placeholder (no real names/dates), the embedded Pkginfo XML string required NO manual scrubbing this time -- unlike the original capture, which needed a hand-scrub of a real employee username in _metadata.created_by (mock-capture's automatic anonymizer does not parse into embedded plist strings, a still-open, separately-tracked gap). REAL-WIRE FINDING (still holds, reconfirmed on this placeholder re-capture): MacOsSoftwareDeploymentSummaryModelV1's IsManaged comes back as the literal string 'True' (capitalized), not a JSON boolean. The response also carries three distinct icon-blob GUID fields (Large/Medium/Small) even though only one icon blob was uploaded at create time.
